facts.note: At the nine o'clock bell Aurèle had everyone bring out watches; Vauthier's watch was two minutes ahead of the bell.
Piquet in the salon until a quarter to eleven by Vauthier's watch; he went to the hall for his cigar case in his coat; Madame began the piano as he went out and stopped when he returned.
At the temple's ten strokes during the game, the salon clock showed five minutes to ten, and Vauthier remarked on it to Madame.
